title: All-anchor normal reference and actual first-abnormal occupation/output contract
statement: For the exact six-species model at all physical states and arbitrary positive raw rates,the anchor-tied signed phase chart admits a globally proper core-invariant factorial energy. provides: For h(m)=log(|m|!),Phi(z)=min_l sum_i[h(z_i+l*w_i)-(z_i+l*w_i)log(theta_i)+theta_i+theta_i^-1],the signed rank-one convex integer minimum is acquired by doubling/binary search. On the entire unbounded normal class,mu=R^l*(alpha0/alpha3)^floor(A/3)*(beta0/beta3)^floor(D/3)/[alpha_(Amod3)*beta_(Dmod3)*A!B!C!D!E!F!],R=kf/kb,has exact normal adjoint defect zero,including cold zeros. mu is a summable invariant finite measure for Q;normal nonexplosion and closed positive recurrent normal components (absorbing normal states allowed) are source-claimed for Q only.

Set Kc=max(1,R,R^-1),Kp=max(1,alpha0/alpha3,beta0/beta3),K=Kc*Kp,C0=Kc^(1+|z0_E|)/(min_i alpha_i*min_j beta_j). S_r=C0*exp(6K)*E[(1+P)^r],P~Poisson(6K),is an acquired finite Touchard-polynomial envelope for sum_class mu*(1+M)^r.

At h>0,q>0,p=h/(q+h),E_x integral_0^sigma(1+M_t)^r dt<=B_r(x)=S_r/[mu(x)*q(x)*p]. For q=0,h>0,use (1+M(x))^r/h. If h=0,q=B0=alpha0+beta0 and B_r(x)=(1+M(x))^r/B0+sum_i(kappa_i0/B0)*B_r(y_i) at its two actual source0 successors with h(y_i)>0,using the same class/reference. Thus sigma is almost surely finite with finite physical mean from EVERY state.

With Q0=sum alpha_i+sum beta_j+kf+kb and q_full<=Q0*(1+M)^7,E J_full(sigma)<=Q0*B_7(x). Every actual last abnormal channel has |Delta M|<=7;R(y)<=C_R*(1+M(y))^p gives E R(X_sigma)<=C_R*8^p*Q0*B_(p+7)(x). This is stopped full activity,not a full-chain stationary activity moment.

Old globally defined Vhat_ang fits the polynomial output bound;new signed factorial energy squared fits with p=4. Low-low outputs retain their true corner value;an appended actual corner has its separate <=5-event clock/count paid. Every peer and terminal failure output is retained.
